results.overview: A story of a fall from grace after reaching the glory of Olympic champion Gervasio Deferr, told in two parts: the past, with the different Olympic Games that Gervasio won, taking us back to Sydney, Athens, and Beijing. And, on the other hand, the present, focused on the days it will take him to visit his mother, who has suffered a heart attack while in hospital. A crucial event that will undoubtedly mark the athlete's destiny for the rest of his life.
results.name: The Big Leap

results.overview: Follow a group of diverse, down-on-their-luck characters attempting to change their lives by participating in a potentially life-ruining reality dance show that builds to a live production of “Swan Lake.”
results.name: The Big Leap
